No entry or off_on_purpose marker has a `pending` field; the only match is the prose word at line 246, and the first 50 lines show only the legacy shape `{name, default: "true", stage, on_values?}`. Neither STABLE_ROLLBACK_ENABLED nor GH_CALL_COUNTER_ENABLED appears anywhere in the checkout. Final CI has not run on head eeb9152a, so failed_count 0 is not a passing signal, and ci/final is still blocked.
